title: Injera
description: Injera is a Ethiopia classic prepared with teff flour, injera starter. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Injera made from teff flour with the cataloged injera starter and long active fermentation; sourness depends on starter activity.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Ferment the teff batter with the injera starter in a covered nonreactive vessel for roughly 48 hours, until distinctly bubbly and pleasantly sour. Discard if spoiled.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Swirl a very thin layer of sour batter on a hot nonstick griddle; cover and cook ONLY from below until the porous top is dry, without flipping.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
